item.title: [infoq] 将Pod作为worker而非智能体：在Kubernetes上重新思考AI智能体的部署单元
item.description: In a CNCF blog post, Lin Sun argues that Pods should serve as the execution unit for AI agents but not as the deployment, identity, or lifecycle unit. The post contrasts treating each agent as a first-class Kubernetes workload with a control-plane approach like Google's Agent Substrate, which manages WorkerPools, Workers, and ActorTemplates above Kubernetes. Platform engineers can weigh these two trade-offs.

item.description: Meitu's MT Lab proposes a self-prompting approach to scene-text editing: it extracts style cues like color and texture from the input image, then feeds them with a rendered glyph prompt and the full image into a multimodal diffusion transformer for encoder-free end-to-end editing. Accepted at ICML 2026, it combines self-supervised pretraining with fine-tuning on about 4,000 human-curated pairs, improving style consistency for multilingual and open-vocabulary text over OCR-dependent or fixed-voca

item.description: Cloudflare unveiled a developer preview that lets sites enable WebMCP with a panel toggle, giving browser-based AI agents structured tools instead of scraping or UI automation. The implementation injects bridge.js, with two authoring paths — document.modelContext API and declarative HTML form annotations — and ships toolkits for Content Credentials and Site MCP, with more toolkits to come.

item.description: The author built v2ex.fyi, a frontend-only perpetual DEX, in a few hours using Orderly Network's Perp Anything, GPT-assisted tweaks, and Cloudflare Pages deployment — no servers involved. It works as a static page calling on-chain contracts and a shared order book; the post also warns readers to interact only with zero-balance test wallets and avoid linking real identities.

item.title: [infoq] Buildpacks 将容器加固控制点从 Dockerfile 中移出
item.description: Cloud Native Buildpacks graduated from CNCF on July 17, 2026 after positioning itself as a security alternative to per-service Dockerfiles: platform teams, not app teams, control base image patches. Its rebase command rewrites the run-image digest in the OCI manifest, applying a patched base image in milliseconds without a rebuild. BellSoft followed on July 21 with a hardened Paketo builder based on Alpaquita Linux.

item.title: [v2ex] [程序员] geek-five-layer-throttling-stack
item.description: A technical write-up dissects Chrome's five-layer throttling of background tabs and pairs each layer with a workaround. It opens with a familiar scraper failure—an infinite-scroll page returns 20 items then stops when the tab isn't visible—and argues the cause is Chrome's architecture, not your code. The fixes are collected in Scrapewright, an open-source taxonomy that includes visibility-state overrides and keep-alive loops.

Developers should review API changes and update their toolchains; those debugging goroutine leaks will find the new profiles especially helpful.
